summary: The first genuinely better week on this account since July, and it was almost entirely the client's doing. SHE PAID US OFF. A third tranche landed 2026-09-12 ('Another portion' / 'Of invoice sent ✅') with a screenshot of what was left ('Left TOTAL will be closing out on this as it drops'), and on 2026-09-17 she cleared it: '✅✅✅' / 'Closed out'. That ends six consecutive reporting periods carrying a balance and is the first time this account has been clear since roughly 2026-08-11. She did it unprompted, without one complaint about value, after a year in which she has never refused and never disputed a cent. STEPHSKI RAN THE BEST BILLING WEEK ON RECORD. She broke her seven-day silence on 2026-09-13, warned the client a day ahead that the invoice was coming and told her to pull her OF withdrawal early so the funds would land in time (2026-09-14), issued the Sep 1-14 invoice on schedule (2026-09-15), nudged once (2026-09-16) and acknowledged the closeout (2026-09-17). WE STILL CANNOT SAY WHAT WE HAVE BEEN PAID. Not one dollar figure has been stated in this chat since 2026-08-11 - 38 days, three invoices and four payment tranches ago - and instead of reconciling, Stephski asked the client to do it for us: 'Can you please include totals you send in these screenshots so I can track easier on our side ❤️' (2026-09-13). Worse, we only learned at 20:52 on 2026-09-17 that the money had gone to the wrong place: 'just a reminder that we need you to send to the business account not Derreks personal if possible'. The Sep 15 invoice also announced yet another change to the account details ('Please note a slight name change to the account') - the eighth payment-rail disruption in thirteen months, landed in the middle of a payoff. VIVEK SURFACED AND VANISHED AGAIN. Mayson tagged him on 2026-09-14 ('Hey @fonta can we do anything about LAs facebook?') and he replied inside seventeen minutes for the first time in nineteen days - 'Yeah' / 'On it' / 'Support is up' / 'Let me check' - and the client lit up: '👀👀👀' / 'Fingers crossed'. He has said nothing in the four days since. The Facebook 'not recommended' flag is now 356 days old, 33 of them with full account access, and the only reason it moved at all is that a colleague chased on her behalf; she has not raised it herself since 2026-09-03, fifteen days. AND THE ONE THING WE NEVER MISSED, WE MISSED. Michelle's weekly DMCA leak-removal update did not arrive. The run was unbroken from 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-08 - ten deliveries - and the next one was due 2026-09-15. Nothing came, and Michelle has not posted at all since 2026-09-10. The 'Lauryn chat team' vendor group is now silent for 100 days; a ChatAddUser event fired at 22:02 on 2026-09-17 and nobody was introduced. Mayson did ask her about a custom on 2026-09-17 - the first revenue-side ask in the thread in 107 days - but sent a bare spreadsheet link with no fan, no price and no deadline. The content-Drive contradiction went completely unmentioned for nineteen days and she has still uploaded nothing.
